summaryForNext: Plan complete: 12 changes, all goal-backed, OpenSpec backend. TWO OPERATOR DECISIONS reshaped it mid-stage: (1) goal 5 PostgreSQL was proposed as a scope CUT, judge raised CRITICAL, operator chose KEEP THE GOAL -> changes 4/5a/5b/6 now implement it for real; (2) auth was unsourced, operator RATIFIED it as goal 6 and goals.md was amended (6 goals now, not 5). ORDER: publish-fork-container-image + dns-a-record-prerequisite (R1, parallel; DNS is external/Manual and is the long pole) -> provision-namespace-and-pull-secret -> deploy-daemon-workload + provision-postgres-cluster (parallel) -> expose-via-shared-gateway -> SITE LIVE on SQLite, goals 1-4 verifiable -> decide-postgres-backend-design (spike) -> implement-postgres-daemon-backend -> cut-over-deployment-to-postgres (goal 5 observable) -> gate-authenticated-access -> surface-authenticated-identity (goal 6) -> document-deployment-runbook. FIRST CHANGE TO APPLY: publish-fork-container-image (S/Low/small; no workflow edit - cut a v*.*.* tag; acceptance asserts git diff touches NO .github/workflows file). WARNINGS carried from adversarial review (2 rounds, both BLOCK, cap reached, accepted at cap; judge gpt-5.5 vs producer claude-opus-5 over rest-gateway = verified-distinct, genuinely cross-model unlike assess which fell back to harness-native both rounds): (a) SECURITY - expose-via-shared-gateway creates a TEMPORARY unauthenticated HTTPRoute named open-design-direct; gate-authenticated-access MUST delete it in the same change or two routes match the host and auth is bypassable; acceptance requires exactly one HTTPRoute for design.know-me.tools backed by flint-gate; (b) the site is INTENTIONALLY unauthenticated between R4 and R8 - a real exposure window, reorderable if unacceptable; (c) OD_PROJECT_STORAGE/project-storage.ts is documented as OUT of goal 5 (blob storage, not a database option) - a broader reading of 'database options' would pull it in, recorded as an unresolved interpretation; (d) implement-postgres-daemon-backend adds the workspace's FIRST Postgres client - acceptance requires pnpm install, committed lockfile, Nix pnpm deps hash refresh check, pnpm guard, pnpm typecheck, package-scoped daemon test/build vs baseline, PR-checklist declaration; (e) daemon test baseline is UNKNOWN (540s timeout) and MUST be captured before change 5b, which propagates an async boundary through the 79 files importing the db handle; (f) final plan text post-dates the last review and carries no adversarial scrutiny. model_policy absent from project.json so all phases default to frontier (logged to model-routing.log); per-change Model class derived from complexity rules, no concrete models resolvable.
